domains.name: Processing Speed
domains.description: Speed and efficiency of cognitive processing; ability to quickly analyze complex information
domains.interpretation_template: High processing speed means you think quickly and manage complexity well. You excel in fast-paced environments and can rapidly analyze multiple data sources.
domains.strengths_description: Quick analysis, rapid decision-making, efficient information handling
domains.development_prompt: Processing speed is already a strength. Consider leveraging it to develop deeper analytical insights.

domains.name: Memory
domains.description: Capacity to encode, store, and retrieve information; working and long-term memory
domains.interpretation_template: Your memory capacity allows you to retain and retrieve information effectively. You can hold and work with complex information over time.
domains.strengths_description: Information retention, pattern recall, knowledge accumulation
domains.development_prompt: Strengthen memory through spaced repetition and active recall techniques.

domains.name: Attention
domains.description: Ability to focus on relevant information, sustain attention, and manage distractions
domains.interpretation_template: Your attention capacity allows you to focus deeply and sustain concentration on complex tasks.
domains.strengths_description: Focus consistency, distraction management, sustained concentration
domains.development_prompt: Enhance attention through mindfulness practices and optimized work environment design.

domains.name: Reasoning
domains.description: Ability to think logically, solve problems systematically, and understand abstract concepts
domains.interpretation_template: Strong reasoning allows you to understand complex relationships and solve problems systematically.
domains.strengths_description: Logical thinking, systematic problem-solving, abstract understanding
domains.development_prompt: Deepen reasoning through exposure to diverse problem types and cross-disciplinary learning.

domains.name: Decision Integrity
domains.description: Quality of decision-making; ability to weigh options and make sound judgments
domains.interpretation_template: Your decision-making is sound and well-reasoned. You consider options carefully before choosing.
domains.strengths_description: Thoughtful analysis, balanced judgment, quality decisions
domains.development_prompt: Improve decision integrity by considering longer timeframes and broader contexts.

domains.name: Emotional Intelligence
domains.description: Ability to recognize, understand, and manage emotions in self and others
domains.interpretation_template: Your emotional intelligence allows you to navigate interpersonal situations with awareness and sensitivity.
domains.development_prompt: Strengthen emotional intelligence through active listening and perspective-taking practices.

domains.name: Originality
domains.description: Creative thinking; ability to generate novel ideas and make original connections
domains.interpretation_template: You generate novel ideas and make creative connections. You approach problems from unique angles.
domains.strengths_description: Creative thinking, novel idea generation, original approaches
domains.development_prompt: Develop originality through exposure to diverse fields and creative problem-solving exercises.

domains.name: Metacognition
domains.description: Understanding of how you think and learn; ability to reflect on and manage cognitive processes
domains.interpretation_template: Strong metacognition means you understand how you learn and think. You can reflect on and adjust your strategies.
domains.strengths_description: Self-awareness, learning strategy awareness, cognitive flexibility
domains.development_prompt: Deepen metacognition through structured reflection and learning journal practices.
